steps.en: Install the single package that bundles every primitive
steps.zh: 装上打包了全部原语的单一包

steps.en: Compose a primitive from its named parts
steps.zh: 用具名部件拼出一个原语

steps.en: Tracks open/closed state and exposes it as a data attribute on each part
steps.zh: 管理开合状态，并以 data 属性暴露在每个部件上

steps.en: Write all visual styles yourself, keyed on that state
steps.zh: 所有视觉样式自己写，按这个状态来切换

steps.en: Handles focus, keyboard keys, Esc/outside-click dismissal and ARIA roles
steps.zh: 处理焦点、键盘按键、Esc 和点外部关闭，以及 ARIA 角色

steps.en: Positions floating content next to its trigger and flips it on collision
steps.zh: 把浮层定位在触发器旁边，碰到边缘自动翻转

value.en: Accessible, keyboard-correct widgets with no visual opinions — the look is entirely your design system's
value.zh: 无障碍、键盘行为正确的控件，不带任何视觉主张——长什么样完全由你的设计系统决定

sources: https://github.com/radix-ui/website/blob/main/data/primitives/docs/overview/getting-started.mdx (npm install radix-ui@latest; Popover.Root/Trigger/Portal/Content; add your own className styles)
https://github.com/radix-ui/website/blob/main/data/primitives/docs/components/popover.mdx (focus managed; collision handling; keyboard interactions incl. Esc)
